honest_framing.purpose: directive_2026_10_16 acceptance on the FSMA line: does the FUSED adapted scorer reach >= max(A,B) on >=4/5 metals with Holm significance?
honest_framing.component_numbers_stay_reported: A and B are re-measured here and reported alongside merged; the directive changes the final model's definition, not the facts.
honest_framing.no_pooled_mean: Ru is ~64% of the deduplicated cohort; the per-metal table is the unit.
honest_framing.device_note: FU4 owns its device: the published cuda:1 K-curve is NOT the baseline here; A, B and merged are all measured on one device. The source-cache key contains str(device), so a cuda:0 run retrains its own sources.
honest_framing.stack_note: merged_stack is SKIPPED at K<20 (inner folds too small for a 2-feature merger); it is not imputed.
